stages.name: Effects of unemployment
stages.title: Effects of unemployment
stages.sub: What rising unemployment means for households and for the firms that sell to them and hire from them.

steps.q: A factory closes in a downturn and workers there lose their jobs. What happens to the wages they were earning?
steps.right: They stop, the workers have no wage
steps.wrong: They stay the same, redundancy pay replaces them
steps.hint: If you no longer have a job, does the pay from that job carry on?

steps.q: Without their old wage, and with only benefits or savings to rely on, how much can these workers afford to buy each week?
steps.hint: Think about a weekly shop on benefits compared with a weekly shop on a wage.

steps.q: Across the whole economy, if many households have less to spend, what happens to their overall spending?
steps.hint: You already established individual spending power falls. What does that do when added up across many households?
